page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with small marginal notes at the left of the paragraphs. Running head at top, page number at top right. Catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: dabũt.Erũt,inquit,filiæ Moab,id est,multi ex diuersis uiculis ac ciuitatibus (ita namq; per metaphoram filiæ uiculos & ciuitates minores repræsentant) sicut auis emissa,recedens de nido: hoc est, erunt ipsimet profu gi, oberrantes, nusquam certam habentes sedem, idq; ad Arnon, flumen in Moabitorum confinijs (ludic.11.) ubi innumerabiles conuenient, atq; inde in uarias re- giones spargentur.Pulchra similitudo,& qua tali cri- mine digna pœna optimè describitur.

Adducite consilium, facite.) En iam crimen,uidelicet crudelitate in pauperes profugos,quam mira acerbitate & cum farcasmo obijcit.Est enim sententia:Tunc quidem,ubi omni malorum genere sentie tis uos obrutos, ipsi fatebimini grauissimè uos peccas se,qui non prudentius cõsultaueritis, quomodo paupe ribus profugis in medio meridiani æstus atq; afflictio- num esse potuissetis in umbram nocturnam & refrige rium:sed superuacanea erit omnis uestra hac de re co- gitatio, nihil amplius poteritis efficere, neque etiam tunc opus erit aliquid huiusmodi præstetis.Hic iterum uis orationis præcipua, ex accomoda pendet pronun- ciatione ac gestu. Occurrit hic mutatio numeri, fre- quens linguæ sanctæ.
Quoniam in nihilum redactus.) Ratio quare tunc non proderit, uel non opus erit, ut Moa- bitæ de humanitate erga pauperes profugos exh:ben- da confilium ineant. Quia,inquit,tunc nulla necessitas

page.notes: Printed "dabŭt" and "Erŭt" read as dabunt and Erunt, with the tilde for the omitted n. The lead-in phrases "Adducite consilium, facite.)" and "Quoniam in nihilum redactus.)" are small italic glosses at the start of paragraphs; I have read them as marginal notes on the left. The "Quia" is underlined in print. The signature "l 5" and the catchword "nostros" sit at the foot right of the last line. The "exh:ben-da" colon is as printed. The text ends mid-sentence at the foot, and the catchword "nostros" continues on the next page.
